description: Top DeFi yields (APY) across ALL chains and protocols, highest first, source DefiLlama — for an agent hunting the single best yield opportunity right now, with no chain/token filter. Optional parameters: ?limit=<n> (1-100, default 10), ?min_tvl=<usd> (minimum pool TVL, default 0). Costs $0.05 via x402 (USDC).

limit.description: Number of pools to return (1-100, default 10).

min_tvl.description: Minimum pool TVL in USD. Optional, default 0.
